Local changes to uxplay (search for "LOCAL ADDITION"), to re-apply when updating:
  photos      on_photo callback (lib/raop.h), PUT /photo route (lib/raop.c), handler
              (lib/http_handlers.h)
  slideshows  on_slideshow / on_slideshow_photo callbacks and raop_slideshow_request()
              (lib/raop.h), routes and connection bookkeeping (lib/raop.c), handlers
              (lib/http_handlers.h), and collecting reverse-HTTP responses instead of
              discarding them (lib/httpd.c, lib/httpd.h)
  bug fix     lib/httpd.c ("LOCAL FIX"): everything received on a reverse-HTTP connection is
              a response; upstream only recognised that for a connection's first bytes
